title: Lunge
subtitle: Build a readable lunge with a reachable response and a useful recovery.
summary: The boss commits its body along a short line to close distance.
overview: The boss commits its body along a short line to close distance, converting open space into immediate contact danger and a new final position.
learning: Tune the signal, commitment, geometry, response, and recovery of a lunge as one rule.

demo.title: Test the lunge
phaseDescriptions: Use a compressed stance, fixed facing, and a clear line from the boss to the destination; lock the direction before the damaging movement begins.
Let the player sidestep the line, cross over it, interrupt the preparation, or bait the destination, depending on the game’s movement verbs.
The boss brakes at the committed destination and cannot immediately steer into another hit, giving a player who cleared the body line time to re-engage.

steps.title: Can the player read the complete rule?
steps.body: Use a compressed stance, fixed facing, and a clear line from the boss to the destination; lock the direction before the damaging movement begins.

steps.title: Is the intended response reachable?
steps.body: Let the player sidestep the line, cross over it, interrupt the preparation, or bait the destination, depending on the game’s movement verbs.

steps.title: Does recovery create a useful outcome?
steps.body: The boss brakes at the committed destination and cannot immediately steer into another hit, giving a player who cleared the body line time to re-engage.

mistakes.title: Late homing turns a readable lunge into a tracking hit and invalidates the position chosen during the tell
mistakes.body: Late homing turns a readable lunge into a tracking hit and invalidates the position chosen during the tell.

mistakes.title: The cue and active geometry disagree
mistakes.body: If the visible lunge cue promises a different area or timing, the player cannot carry the learned rule into the next cycle.

designNotes.title: Tune the complete rule
designNotes.body: Balance travel distance against preparation time and recovery; verify that the player can clear the boss’s full body, not only its center line.

designNotes.title: Escalate one variable at a time
designNotes.body: Chain a second lunge toward the new position or vary the travel distance while preserving the same commitment cue.

designNotes.title: Prove the recovery
designNotes.body: The boss brakes at the committed destination and cannot immediately steer into another hit, giving a player who cleared the body line time to re-engage.

story.title: What the mechanic communicates
story.body: The boss commits its body along a short line to close distance, converting open space into immediate contact danger and a new final position. The encounter uses that rule as a short promise: a visible signal, a committed action, and a result the player can verify.

adaptation.title: Adapt it to the player verbs
adaptation.body: Let the player sidestep the line, cross over it, interrupt the preparation, or bait the destination, depending on the game’s movement verbs. Balance travel distance against preparation time and recovery; verify that the player can clear the boss’s full body, not only its center line.

distinction.title: Keep the mechanic distinct
distinction.body: Late homing turns a readable lunge into a tracking hit and invalidates the position chosen during the tell. Do not hide that distinction behind extra effects or tracking that the announced rule does not contain.

lensNotes.body: The signal must reveal the relevant timing and geometry before commitment.
After commitment, the rule stops changing in ways the signal did not announce.
The complete player extent and the active region determine whether the route is real.
The response uses an ordinary supported verb and produces an observable result.

examples.game: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
